content.text:
All 263 tests pass, including the 25 in `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`.

## Summary

The repo already had a duplicate-owner 409 check, but its semantics were wrong — it only rejected when **last name AND telephone** both matched. The spec requires rejecting when the **telephone alone** is already used by any other owner.

Changes:

1. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — rewrote `isDuplicateOwner` to scan all owners (`findAllOwners()`) and match on telephone only, dropping the last-name condition. `addOwner` already returns `409 CONFLICT` when this returns true.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.java`** — added `createOwnerConflictWhenSameTelephoneDifferentLastName`, which posts a second owner with a different name/address/city but the same telephone and asserts `409`. The existing tests (identical duplicate → 409, same last-name+phone → 409, same last-name different phone → 201) remain valid under the new rule.
